name: Orange Jello Salad
description: A simple orange Jello salad with mandarin oranges and Dream Whip.
recipeIngredient: 1 small package Dream Whip (not pudding or instant vanilla)

recipeInstructions.text: Put the first 3 ingredients into a saucepan and cook until clear.
Cool the mixture.
Mix Dream Whip according to package instructions.
Drain oranges and add Dream Whip and oranges to the cooled mixture.
Allow to cool completely before serving.

keywords: orange Jello salad, mandarin oranges, Dream Whip

_similar.name: Orange-Pineapple Jello
_similar.description: A fruity Jello dessert with orange, pineapple, and nuts.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup frozen orange juice concentrate

recipeInstructions.text: Drain pineapple and reserve syrup. Add water to make ¾ cup.
Heat the liquid to boiling.
Place Jello in a bowl and add hot liquid, pineapple, and orange juice concentrate.
Chill until thickish.
Fold in Dream Whip along with marshmallows and pecans.

_similar.name: Party-Time Salad
_similar.description: A creamy lime Jello salad with pineapple, cream cheese, and celery.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat pineapple juice and hot water to measure 1 cup.
Dissolve Jello powder in hot liquid and stir, then add ¾ cup cold water.
Let partially set.
Add cream cheese and mix with beaters.
Add crushed pineapple, whipped cream, and celery.
Pour into a 1½ quart mould and chill until firm.

_similar.keywords: party-time salad, lime Jello, cream cheese, pineapple

_similar.name: Sliced Bean Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and sweet pickled bean salad made with green or yellow beans, perfect for serving with onion and cream.

recipeInstructions.text: Slice the beans and cook until tender enough to pierce with a fork.
Drain the cooked beans and pack them into jars.
In a saucepan, bring the sugar, water, vinegar, and salt to a boil to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the beans in the jars.
To serve, pour off the liquid and add chopped onion and cream.

_similar.keywords: pickled bean salad, sweet and tangy, preserved beans

_similar.name: Cottage Cheese Jellied Salad
_similar.description: A light and fruity salad made with cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts, set in a gelatin mold.
recipeIngredient: 3 oz package orange or lemon flavored gelatin

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.
Add mayonnaise and whisk to blend.
Chill until the mixture starts to set.
Add cottage cheese, pineapple, and walnuts. Combine well.
Pour the mixture into a clear glass bowl or a 4-cup lightly oiled mold.

_similar.keywords: cottage cheese salad, jellied salad, pineapple salad

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing
